commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Fire Lord Azula ({1}{U}{B}{R} 4/4 legendary Human Noble; Avatar: The Last Airbender tla, released 2025-11-21; commander-legal, not a Game Changer, no project exception). Firebending 2 (attack: add {R}{R} until end of combat). Whenever we cast a spell while Azula is attacking, copy it; copies of permanent spells become tokens. Plan: a Bracket 5 cEDH turbo shell (25 lands plus an MDFC, fast mana, free interaction, Quicken/Crimson Wisps/Expedite-style enablers) that wins with Thassa's Oracle + Demonic Consultation/Tainted Pact, Underworld Breach lines (Lotus Petal/LED + Brain Freeze, Wheel, Grinding Station), or Azula + Narset's Reversal + Frantic Search/Turnabout loops during her attack.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 5 (cEDH). Game Changers: 20 in baseline and candidate (Ad Nauseam, Ancient Tomb, Chrome Mox, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship, Force of Will, Gamble, Grim Monolith, Imperial Seal, Jeska's Will, Lion's Eye Diamond, Mana Vault, Mox Diamond, Mystical Tutor, Necropotence, Orcish Bowmasters, Rhystic Study, Thassa's Oracle, Underworld Breach, Vampiric Tutor). Commander Spellbook find-my-combos: 9 -> 10 complete combos (adds 11-4276-7089 Azula + Narset's Reversal + Turnabout; none lost); almost-included 98 -> 105. The Azula loops are finite and optional per iteration; with Samut cut, split second no longer stops them.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first to Azula's text: every add is a spell (or land) whose value doubles while she attacks. Turnabout is a commander loop piece; Unexpected Windfall and Flashback double under her copy; Sink is a copied bounce; Mistrise protects her and creature win pieces. Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the most similar approved Grixis turbo/storm decks, baseline -> candidate, canonical Archidekt exports): Norman Osborn 76 -> 74; Kefka, Court Mage 76 -> 74; Kess, Dissident Mage 74 -> 73; Rograkh/Silas Renn 74 -> 71; Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge 73 -> 70; Evelyn, the Covetous 68 -> 66. Turnabout and Flashback appear in no other Grixis export; Unexpected Windfall only in Doctor Doom; Sink into Stupor only in Saruman and Tetsuo; Mistrise Village is shared with Evelyn and Kess. Samut, Tyrant is shared only with Rograkh/Silas, Vivi only with Abaddon. Every add is copied by Azula's attack trigger. Owner-removed or rejected cards and classes (Storm-Kiln Artist, Spellseeker, Dualcaster Mage/Twinflame/Twinning Staff, Lightning Greaves, Seething Song, Snapcaster, Brainstorm, Gitaxian Probe, Leyline of Anticipation, Veyran, Archmage, The Last Agni Kai, Training Center) are not re-added; Spellseeker and Storm-Kiln appear only in the staged Pass C test lists. One owner addition is cut and FLAGGED (Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun), with a keep-Samut alternative staged.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps:
All 99 library cards were reviewed by quantity (99 rows, all 1x).
Roles:
- 26 lands in the baseline: Ancient Tomb, Arena of Glory, Cavern of Souls, City of Brass, Mana Confluence, Command Tower, Emergence Zone, Exotic Orchard, Gemstone Caverns, Otawara, Starting Town, 4 original duals, 3 shocks, 9 fetches; the candidate cuts Exotic Orchard and Gemstone Caverns and adds Mistrise Village plus the Soporific Springs MDFC.
- Fast mana: Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Grim Monolith, Chrome Mox, Mox Diamond, Mox Opal, Lotus Petal, LED, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone, three Talismans, Wishclaw, Dark Ritual, Cabal Ritual, Rite of Flame, Simian Spirit Guide, Big Score; Unexpected Windfall is new; Vivi Ornitier is cut.
- Wins: Thassa's Oracle, Demonic Consultation, Tainted Pact, Underworld Breach, Brain Freeze, Grinding Station, Wheel of Fortune, Jeska's Will, Narset's Reversal, Frantic Search; Turnabout is new.
- Tutors and draw: Demonic, Vampiric, Imperial Seal, Mystical, Gamble, Beseech the Mirror, Necropotence, Ad Nauseam, Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Demand Answers, Borne Upon a Wind, Faerie Mastermind, Wan Shi Tong; Flashback is new.
- Combat-turn enablers: Quicken, Crimson Wisps, Expedite, Birgi, Geist of Saint Thalia.
- Interaction: Force of Will, Force of Negation, Fierce Guardianship, Pact of Negation, Mindbreak Trap, Flusterstorm, Mental Misstep, Pyroblast, Red Elemental Blast, Strix Serenade, Deflecting Swat, Redirect Lightning, Into the Flood Maw, Chain of Vapor, Snap, Repeal, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Orcish Bowmasters, Hexing Squelcher, High Fae Trickster, Valley Floodcaller, Ragavan; Sink into Stupor is new; Swan Song and Samut are cut.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Lands 26 -> 25 plus the Soporific Springs MDFC. R/U/B land sources 21/21/20 -> 19/20/18 (U 21 counting the MDFC; the baseline counts Gemstone Caverns as rainbow, an upper bound). Conditional/tapped lands: Arena of Glory, Starting Town -> plus Mistrise Village. Exact multivariate-hypergeometric castability of Azula (lands plus 2-mana rocks, moxen and rituals excluded): turn 4 on the play 0.4920 -> 0.4905 (MDFC played as land) or 0.4632 (MDFC never a land); turn 5 0.5861 -> 0.5845/0.5565. Turn 2 reads 0 for every list (a model artifact: it excludes Sol Ring/moxen). Average nonland MV 1.849 -> 1.905; creatures 13 -> 11; instants/sorceries 41 -> 44.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Force of Will, Force of Negation, Fierce Guardianship, Pact of Negation, Mindbreak Trap, Flusterstorm, Mental Misstep, Pyroblast, Red Elemental Blast, Strix Serenade, Deflecting Swat, Redirect Lightning, Hexing Squelcher, Cavern of Souls; Mistrise Village is new. Bounce/removal: Into the Flood Maw, Chain of Vapor, Snap, Repeal, An Offer, Orcish Bowmasters; Sink into Stupor is new. Weak points: graveyard hate stops Breach and Flashback; Azula is a 4-mana creature with no protection beyond Deflecting Swat and counters; losing Swan Song and Samut removes two anti-counter pieces (net 0 with Sink and Mistrise).

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Fire Lord Azula cEDH absent, optimized 300/2056, general absent; live Scryfall batch; OFF-RANKING for cEDH (absent from the Azula cEDH page)
material_candidates.role: {2}{U}{U} instant: choose artifact, creature or land; tap all untapped or untap all tapped permanents of that type target player controls.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun, an OWNER ADDITION (2026-10-14: split second on our spells; the owner noted triggers still work). FLAGGED override of an explicit owner addition.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: While Azula attacks, Turnabout + Narset's Reversal is a complete Spellbook combo (11-4276-7089): two Turnabout resolutions per iteration untap all our lands for net 2L - 6 mana (unbounded storm at L >= 3 lands, unbounded mana at L >= 4). Outside the loop, Azula's copy gives two modes: untap our lands and tap an opponent's lands at instant speed. Combos 9 -> 10.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Four mana and situational outside Azula's attack; dead in hand when Azula is answered. Samut's upside (our instants/sorceries can't be countered while Samut is out) is lost.
material_candidates.reason: Samut's split second is a nonbo with the deck's own engine: per the 2026-08-21 Samut ruling and 702.61a/b, the bargained Beseech free cast is impossible and Narset's Reversal can't be cast into Frantic Search or Turnabout. Pass C Priority 1 flagged this exact problem. Keep-Samut four-swap staged.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Five one-for-one swaps: Turnabout for the owner-added Samut (FLAGGED), Sink into Stupor for Exotic Orchard, Unexpected Windfall for Vivi Ornitier, Flashback for Swan Song and Mistrise Village for Gemstone Caverns. Losses: Samut's split-second protection, Swan Song's one-mana counter, Vivi's ping wincon and mana, Gemstone's opening-hand acceleration and Exotic Orchard's rainbow mana; creatures 13 -> 11. Protection count net 0.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C Priority 1 (+Spellseeker / -Samut) was run as a bounded finite test: Samut is seen by turn 4 on the play 0.101, with Beseech 0.0093, and Samut blocks Beseech's free cast and both Reversal loops whenever it is out. The primary cuts Samut for Turnabout (a combo piece) instead of re-adding the owner-removed Spellseeker; the exact Spellseeker list is staged. Pass C Priority 2 (+Storm-Kiln / -Big Score) was run as a finite Treasure ledger for k = 0..6 combat spells: the Artist needs k >= 4 to beat a copied Big Score's mana and never draws; both Storm-Kiln lists are staged.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The owner-added Samut has split second, which per the 2026-08-21 ruling stops our own bargained Beseech free cast and stops Narset's Reversal from being cast into Frantic Search: the commander's main loop is disabled whenever Samut is out. The mana base also carried two lands whose colours are conditional (Exotic Orchard, Gemstone Caverns).
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Five swaps: Turnabout replaces Samut and adds a 10th Spellbook combo; Sink replaces Exotic Orchard as a land that is also an answer; Unexpected Windfall (42.5% staple) replaces Vivi; Flashback replaces Swan Song (marginal); Mistrise Village replaces Gemstone Caverns (most marginal). Combos 9 -> 10, none lost; Azula castability 0.4920 -> 0.4905 by turn 4 on the play with the MDFC as a land.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: The five-swap floor was reached with five swaps that each stand on their own; the floor was not a target and no sixth swap cleared the bar. Every remaining incumbent was re-read against the candidate pool: ten post-floor challenges were recorded on Azula-specific grounds, and a six-swap package (Mox Amber over Fellwar Stone) is staged as a complete 100.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Mox Amber is free but dead without a legendary creature; Fellwar casts Azula sooner (0.4905 vs 0.4638 by turn 4 on the play).
Artist makes 2 Treasures per combat spell but needs a turn of setup; copied Big Score gives 4 cards and 4 Treasures at instant speed.
Wan Shi Tong is a flash value body and a 43.6% staple; the Artist is owner-removed.
Culling is a one-shot ritual that needs a creature to sacrifice; Talisman is permanent mana toward a turn-3 Azula.
Dramatic Reversal needs enough rocks to be positive; Repeal is an owner-added answer.
Mana Drain needs UU and its mana arrives in the next main phase, missing Azula's combat window; Strix costs one U.
Stingcaster duplicates the Flashback add on a slower body.
City of Traitors makes only colourless mana and is sacrificed on the next land drop; Azula needs {U}{B}{R}.
Reiterate adds no new loop and was rejected by the deep review.
Protection matters more than removal after Swan Song and Samut leave.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Mox Amber is a 53% EDHREC cEDH card and a free artifact for Mox Opal.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: It is dead without a legendary creature and lowers turn-4 Azula castability (0.4905 -> 0.4638).

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped at five. Each remaining weak-looking slot beats its best challenger on Azula-specific grounds or is an owner addition kept on its stated reason: Geist, Strix, Repeal, Quicken, Crimson Wisps, Expedite, Grinding Station, Beseech, Mox Opal and Wan Shi Tong are owner additions; Fellwar, Talisman of Indulgence, Wooded Foothills, Big Score, Wheel, Flusterstorm and Redirect Lightning beat their challengers. Cutting more interaction would weaken the stack after Swan Song and Samut are already gone.
